title: Add Skeleton Loading
content: Create skeleton loading components that mimic content structure while loading. Base skeleton: bg-gray-200 rounded animate-pulse. Create variants: SkeletonText (h-4 rounded), SkeletonAvatar (w-10 h-10 rounded-full), SkeletonImage (aspect-video rounded-lg), SkeletonButton (h-10 w-24 rounded-md), SkeletonCard (full card with image, title, text areas). Animation: use animate-pulse or custom shimmer with gradient animation moving left to right. Match exact dimensions of real content to prevent layout shift. Create compound skeletons for common patterns: CardSkeleton, ListItemSkeleton, TableRowSkeleton.

variants.simple: Create animated skeleton placeholders for loading states.
variants.detailed: Create skeleton loading components that mimic content structure while loading. Base skeleton: bg-gray-200 rounded animate-pulse. Create variants: SkeletonText (h-4 rounded), SkeletonAvatar (w-10 h-10 rounded-full), SkeletonImage (aspect-video rounded-lg), SkeletonButton (h-10 w-24 rounded-md), SkeletonCard (full card with image, title, text areas). Animation: use animate-pulse or custom shimmer with gradient animation moving left to right. Match exact dimensions of real content to prevent layout shift. Create compound skeletons for common patterns: CardSkeleton, ListItemSkeleton, TableRowSkeleton.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive skeleton loading system with multiple variants. Base component: div with bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded animate-pulse. Custom shimmer animation: background linear-gradient(-90deg, gray-200 0%, gray-100 50%, gray-200 100%) with background-size: 200% 100% and animate sliding. Variants: SkeletonText (h-4 w-full, with width variants w-3/4 w-1/2 for realistic text), SkeletonHeading (h-6 w-2/3), SkeletonAvatar (w-10 h-10 rounded-full), SkeletonImage (aspect-video or aspect-square rounded-lg), SkeletonButton (h-10 w-24 rounded-md), SkeletonInput (h-10 w-full rounded-md). Compound skeletons: CardSkeleton (image + heading + 2-3 text lines), ListItemSkeleton (avatar + text lines), TableRowSkeleton (multiple cells), ProfileSkeleton (avatar + name + bio). Component props: width, height, rounded variant, animation (pulse/shimmer/none), count for repeating. Accessibility: add aria-label="Loading..." and role="status" on container, aria-busy="true" on parent. Performance: use will-change: opacity for smooth animation, CSS containment. Dark mode support with dark: variants. Prevent layout shift by matching exact real content dimensions.
